history.title: Match history

history.clearText: Removes every saved match. The app starts learning from scratch.

brief.class.ENCHANTER: Enchanter — keeps allies alive and stronger with shields, heals and buffs.
brief.class.CATCHER: Catcher — picks off enemies caught out of position with hooks and stuns.
brief.class.WARDEN: Warden — stays next to the carries and protects them from divers.
brief.class.VANGUARD: Vanguard — a tanky engager who starts the fights for the team.
brief.class.JUGGERNAUT: Juggernaut — a tough melee fighter who wins long fights but is easy to kite.
brief.class.DIVER: Diver — jumps onto the enemy backline and locks down one target.
brief.class.SKIRMISHER: Skirmisher — strong in duels and drawn-out fights in tight spaces.
brief.class.ASSASSIN: Assassin — gets in, kills a squishy target fast and gets out.
brief.class.BURST: Burst mage — deletes a target with a quick combo of spells from range.
brief.class.BATTLEMAGE: Battlemage — deals sustained magic damage in the middle of the fight.
brief.class.ARTILLERY: Artillery — pokes enemies down from very long range before the fight.
brief.class.MARKSMAN: Marksman — steady damage from range with basic attacks; needs protection.
brief.class.SPECIALIST: Specialist — an unusual kit that plays by its own rules.
brief.class.TANK: Tank — soaks damage and disrupts the enemies for the team.
brief.class.FIGHTER: Fighter — a durable melee damage dealer for skirmishes.
brief.class.MAGE: Mage — deals magic damage with abilities from range.
brief.class.SUPPORT: Support — helps the team with utility and vision.
brief.class.OTHER: A champion with a mixed kit.
brief.champ.Yuumi: Attaches to an ally and rides along — heals and speeds them up, but is helpless when knocked off.
brief.champ.Kalista: Hops around between attacks and binds to her support, whom her ultimate can throw into a fight.
brief.champ.Teemo: An annoying ranged laner — blinds, poisons and fills the map with invisible mushroom traps.
brief.champ.Sylas: A melee mage who steals enemy ultimates and turns them against them; heals in fights.
brief.champ.Singed: Runs around leaving a poison trail; flings enemies behind him and baits them into chasing.
tip.stayWithEnchanter: Stay close to {champ} — their shields and heals let you trade and fight harder.
tip.followCatch: When {champ} lands a hook or stun, follow up at once — that is your kill window.
tip.peelForCarry: Stay next to {champ} in fights and keep your shields and disengage for them.
tip.engageForCarry: Engage only when {champ} is close enough to follow up with damage.
tip.waitForEngage: Let {champ} start the fight — do not step up first, follow the engage.
tip.gankCc: Gank the lane of {champ} — their crowd control sets up your kills.
tip.coverImmobile: {champ} has no escapes — cover their lane when the enemy jungler shows up nearby.
tip.skirmishMid: {champ} can fight with you in the river — move together for the scuttle crab and invades.
tip.playForGanks: {champ} ganks well — keep your wave near your tower and ping when your opponent overextends.
tip.behindFrontline: Fight behind {champ} — let them take the first hits, then deal your damage.
tip.setUpDive: Save your crowd control for when {champ} jumps in — a stunned target cannot escape.
tip.pokeFirst: {champ} pokes from long range — wear the enemies down before you go in.
tip.fightNearEnchanter: {champ} makes whoever stands next to them stronger — fight close to them.
